config.label: Absolute http(s) API root prefix; the SDK appends /v1/systemone
config.description: Absolute http(s) API root prefix; the SDK appends /v1/systemone. Required at startup with no provider default or host allowlist; custom path prefixes are supported. Must not include credentials, a query or a fragment.

config.label: Default model name sent to the configured endpoint
config.description: Default model name sent to the configured endpoint. Required at startup with no default or model allowlist; a per-call model argument overrides it and a blank per-call override is rejected.

config.label: API credential for the configured endpoint, sent as a Bearer token
config.description: API credential for the configured endpoint, sent as a Bearer token. Optional at startup (tool discovery works without it); decision calls require it and return MISSING_API_KEY until it is set.

config.label: Total request deadline in milliseconds, including automatic SDK retries (1–120000)
config.description: Total request deadline in milliseconds, including automatic SDK retries (1–120000)
